_why: The machines that are supposed to be running our CI. The runner watchdog counted online runners PER REPOSITORY and was satisfied by one, so when all 24 of the office PC's runners were deregistered on 2026-08-25 the laptop kept every repository's count above zero and nothing alarmed for a week. This file is what makes a whole machine's absence visible.
_naming: Runners are registered as wsl-<MACHINE>-<repo>[-N]. The MACHINE here is the Windows machine name, exactly as it appears in that registration.
_adding_a_machine: Add its name here in the same commit that registers its runners, otherwise the watchdog reports it as UNKNOWN MACHINE.
_do_not_add_the_desktop: DESKTOP-124K6MV is Roger's work PC and is NOT a CI host. He decided that on 2026-08-25, it was written into Audits/CLOSEOUT-two-machines-rules-2026-08-27.md, and he confirmed it again on 2026-09-03: 'The work PC is for work only and not for anything else.' On 2026-09-01 commit 446cfee read its absence as lost build capacity and re-registered 24 runners there without asking him. It is absent ON PURPOSE. If the watchdog ever reports it as UNKNOWN MACHINE, the correct action is to DELETE those runners, never to add the machine back here.
